sourcedFrom: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) (2019 (copyright line, printed p.36))
cleanIntro: The FX-19 is Faxon's 9mm pistol, and one Faxon book covers the line. Two things in it catch owners out: the pistol has no conventional manual safety, and it fires with the magazine removed, so taking the magazine out does not make it safe. The field strip pulls the trigger on the cleared pistol, holds the slide back about 1/8 inch, pulls the slide lock down on both sides and runs the slide off the front of the frame; the recoil spring and barrel then come out of the slide. That is as far as Faxon lets an owner go: further disassembly is for a qualified gunsmith. ⚠ Faxon's book prints no cleaning, lubrication or reassembly procedure, so the checklist below holds only the care rules the book does state.

steps.title: Muzzle safe, magazine out
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction and keep it there. Press the magazine catch and take the magazine out of the pistol.
steps.prose: The magazine coming out is only the first step. The FX-19 has no conventional manual safety, and Faxon is plain that its pistols fire with the magazine removed, so a round in the chamber is still live with the magazine in your hand. Keep your finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard.
steps.quote: Remove the magazine by depressing the magazine catch
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 1, p.26
steps.warn: FAXON FIREARMS PISTOLS WILL FIRE WITH THE MAGAZINE REMOVED.

steps.title: Slide fully back, chambered round ejected
steps.action: Hold the grip with your finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard. With your other hand, grasp the rear of the slide and pull it fully back so any cartridge in the chamber is ejected.
steps.prose: Pull it all the way back, not part way: a short stroke can leave the round on the extractor. Keep your hand and face away from the ejection port as the round comes out.
steps.quote: grasp the rear of the slide with your other hand and pull the slide fully back to eject any cartridge in the chamber
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 2, p.27

steps.title: Slide locked back on the slide stop lever
steps.action: Pull the slide back again and push up on the slide stop lever to lock the slide open.
steps.prose: With the slide held open you can see into the chamber and the magazine well together, which is what the next step needs.
steps.quote: Lock the slide back to the rear by pulling the slide back and pushing up on the slide stop lever
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 3, p.27

steps.title: Chamber and magazine well seen and felt empty
steps.action: Look into the chamber and the magazine well, then check both with a finger. No cartridge may remain in either. Move all ammunition away from the bench before you go on.
steps.prose: Faxon asks for both a visual and a physical check. The pistol does have a loaded chamber indicator, but Faxon warns it is a mechanical device and could fail — your eyes and finger decide, not the indicator.
steps.quote: Visually and physically inspect that both the chamber and magazine well are clear and no ammunition remains in either location
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 4, p.27
steps.warn: ALTHOUGH YOUR PISTOL HAS A LOADED CHAMBER INDICATOR, IT IS A MECHANICAL DEVICE AND COULD FAIL.

steps.title: Slide released forward
steps.action: Release the slide: press the slide stop lever down, or pull the slide fully back and let it go so it runs fully forward.
steps.prose: The strip starts with the slide forward on the empty chamber, not with it locked open.
steps.quote: Release the slide by either pressing the slide stop lever down
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 5, p.28

steps.title: Trigger pulled, muzzle safe
steps.action: With the muzzle pointed in a safe direction, pull the trigger and leave it in its rearmost position.
steps.prose: This is why the chamber was checked twice: the slide will not come off until the trigger has been pulled. Do it only on the pistol you have just seen and felt empty.
steps.quote: WITH THE MUZZLE POINTED IN A SAFE DIRECTION, pull the trigger. The trigger must be in the rearmost position to remove the slide
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 6, p.29

steps.title: Slide drawn back about 1/8 inch
steps.action: Hold the pistol in your firing hand with your fingers across the top of the rear of the slide, in front of the rear sight, and your thumb on the rear of the frame. Pull the slide back about 1/8 inch and hold it there.
steps.prose: Only a short draw. Too far and the slide lock will not release; let go and you have to start again.
steps.quote: Hold your pistol with your firing hand with your fingers across the top of the rear of the slide, in front of the rear sight and your thumb on the rear of the frame.
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 7, p.29

steps.title: Slide lock pulled down on both sides
steps.action: While holding the slide back, use the thumb and index finger of your other hand to pull the slide lock down evenly on both sides of the frame.
steps.prose: Evenly is the point: pulled down on one side only, the lock stays in the way of the slide.
steps.quote: pull the slide lock down evenly on both sides
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 8, p.29

steps.title: Slide pushed forward off the frame
steps.action: Keep the slide lock held down and push the slide forward, off the front of the frame.
steps.prose: If the slide will not come off, Faxon says to go back and repeat the last three steps: trigger pulled, slide drawn back 1/8 inch, slide lock fully pulled down. Do not force it.
steps.quote: While holding the slide lock down, push the slide forward and remove it from the frame.
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 9, p.30

steps.title: Recoil spring out of the slide
steps.action: Turn the slide over. Press the recoil spring forward, toward the muzzle end of the slide, and pivot it out.
steps.prose: The spring is under some tension; keep a thumb on it as it pivots clear so it does not jump.
steps.quote: Press the recoil spring forward (toward the muzzle end of the slide) and pivot it out
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 10, p.30

steps.title: Barrel out of the slide
steps.action: Grasp the barrel by the locking cams. Lift it, slide it forward toward the muzzle end, then pivot it up and pull it back out of the slide.
steps.prose: Lift, forward, pivot up, back — in that order. Pulled straight back, the barrel catches.
steps.quote: Grasp the barrel by the locking cams and lift it and slide it forward (toward the muzzle end) and then pivot it up and pull it back to remove it from the slide
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, step 11, p.30

steps.title: Field strip complete — Faxon's stopping point
steps.action: You now have the frame, the slide, the recoil spring and the barrel. This is as far as Faxon lets an owner take the FX-19.
steps.prose: Faxon draws the line in its own words: no further disassembly by the owner. Anything past this is for a qualified gunsmith. The same goes for parts: Faxon's warranty does not cover compatibility with non-Faxon parts or accessories beyond what its manual sets out, and it is on you to make sure any part you buy is made for its pistols.
steps.quote: NEVER FULLY DISASSEMBLE YOUR PISTOL. ONLY DISASSEMBLE TO THE FOLLOWING STATE (FIGURE 33).
steps.cite: FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual — FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual (© 2019 printed on the back page; file FX-19-Manual.pdf) — Disassembly / Field Stripping, p.31

deepAbsentReason: Faxon's FX-19 Operation and Safety Manual ends owner disassembly at the field strip: slide off the frame, recoil spring and barrel out of the slide (printed pp.26-30). On printed p.31 it warns never to fully disassemble the pistol and says any further disassembly must be performed by a qualified gunsmith. The book prints no deeper procedure, and no cleaning, lubrication or reassembly instructions.

cleaning.name: BEFORE YOU START
tasks: Clean only a pistol you have just cleared: magazine out, chamber and magazine well seen and felt empty
Ammunition moved off the bench before you clean or inspect, as Faxon directs
Eye protection on, and work with adequate ventilation; wash your hands afterwards

cleaning.name: BORE
tasks: Look through the bore before the pistol is loaded again. Faxon warns that even a small obstruction can cause a dangerous increase in pressure

cleaning.name: PARTS
tasks: ⛔ Do not take the frame, slide or barrel further apart than the field strip; Faxon reserves further disassembly for a qualified gunsmith
Never manipulate, adjust or change internal components the manual does not tell you to
Do not alter or replace parts yourself; Faxon says that is work for a qualified gunsmith

reassembly: Faxon's book prints no reassembly procedure. The order below is its field strip run backwards.
Barrel back into the slide: tip it in muzzle-first, pivot it down and let it seat back into the slide.
Recoil spring back into the slide, its front end pressed forward and pivoted down into place under the barrel.
Slide run back onto the frame from the front and drawn fully rearward, then let go so it runs forward into battery.
Check that the slide is fully forward and in battery before the pistol is put away.
fncheck: Faxon's book prints no function check. With the pistol unloaded, no magazine in it and the chamber seen and felt empty: pull the slide fully back and let it run forward, and confirm it goes fully forward and into battery. Pull it back again and push up on the slide stop lever, which must hold the slide open; press the lever down and the slide must run forward again. Insert an empty magazine until it locks, then press the magazine catch and check that it comes out. If anything binds or does not lock, stop: Faxon says any maintenance or service not in the manual is for a qualified gunsmith.
